BiblicalUsage: Cheresh means deaf, whether the ear is shut or the heart is, and the Bible holds both meanings together. God asks Moses who makes the dumb or the deaf, the law forbids cursing the deaf, Isaiah promises the deaf shall hear the words of the book, and the psalmist says he was as a deaf man who heard not.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the God who made the ear can open it, and the day the deaf hear is the day His healing is shown. I hold that spiritual deafness is the deeper danger, because it refuses to hear what God has said.
